title: Chickpea and leek soup
summary: Chickpea and leek soup is a british dinner built around canned chickpeas in water and leeks, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Chickpea and leek soup. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add canned chickpeas in water and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and leeks.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until carrots is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Chickpea and leek soup before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Chickpea and leek soup.
